body: Two-part root cause: matchmakers had died (bots orphaned), then even after restart the client failed silently because PLAY.bat never set REDGARDEN_TICKET_SECRET client-side and there's no human login flow yet. Restarted both matchmaker pools with the shared secret, fixed PLAY.bat (sets the var, added pause so failures are readable). Also did a live sudo-queue audit while at it -- 4 scripts confirmed done and archived, 5 confirmed still pending. Commit a509174. BACKLOG S170-63, S170-64.
title: Fix: matchmaker restart + PLAY.bat missing ticket secret, real connection failure diagnosed
